description: dimabot API (dima-server): the frozen TypeScript backend at 0c71108e, image dimabot-ref:0c71108e built from dimabot/dockerfile, run with the production command and the production variable names with test values only. The Node preload (node/preload.mjs, loaded with NODE_OPTIONS) sends every outbound request to the side's mock and refuses any other destination; S3 and the embeddings sidecar are pointed at the mock through S3_ENDPOINT_URL and LFM2_EMBEDDINGS_URL. The API listens on 3000 inside, remapped to the rig's port. Internal calls to dima-server:3000 and self-calls to api.domdimabot.com are forwarded to the side's own port, as production routes them. Candidate: not ported yet.

mock.startup_reason: Start-up traffic (the AST catalog embedded into Qdrant, the docs site fetched for the assistant, OTLP logs) is the same for every scenario and large; it is compared by its own scenario, not stored in each capture.

routes.reason: INTERNAL_API_URL defaults to http://dima-server:3000 in production: the API calling itself.
Self-calls through the public URL reach this API in production.

mock.compare_reason: posthog-node sends its batches on its own 10 s timer, so whether the start-up $identify batch (or any event's) lands inside a scenario depends on timing. A scenario that checks analytics events sets compare.calls.posthog to multiset and waits for the batch with wait_call.

candidate.unavailable: The Rust binary (dima-server) does not exist yet: record only.
